name: 3in1 Miss Lara Blusher & Highlighter | Shade #2
description:
【High-quality products】New high-quality products with exquisite and elegant design. 



[3-in-1 design] The product adopts a three-layer 3-in-1 design, and one plate contains highlights, contouring and blush, which is more convenient to use. 



[Fine texture] The powdery texture is fine and smooth, easy to spread, easy to apply, and the color is natural. 



【Remarkable color rendering effect】The color is full, the color is rich, and the color rendering is high. It has two different color matching styles, which can be selected according to your needs. 



【Long-lasting makeup】Waterproof and sweatproof, not easy to smudge, not easy to take off makeup. 



【Compact Design】Small size, easy to carry, and built-in mirror, you can touch up makeup anytime, anywhere, suitable for various occasions.
